constraints.rule: market_id is stable and never reused for another event or market type
one market identity has at most one current version pointer
market version number is unique per market and supersession is acyclic
calculation references exactly one market version and immutable configuration digest
published price references exactly one calculation and cannot be updated or deleted
fair probabilities and published odds are non-negative finite values
published odds use a versioned rounding mode and preserve the separate fair probability
historical facts reject UPDATE and DELETE through database privileges and trigger protection
override proposer and approver are distinct identities and both decisions are audited
payload discriminator enforces exclusive sport-result versus administrative/lifecycle payload
sport result references the exact confirmedVersionId from V16 without copying or synthesizing scores
administrative walkover, abandonment, cancellation and postponement carry no sports score
foreign keys to 04-16 authority and 04-19 roster are added only in their later ratified forward-fix
legacy V16/V24 rows remain readable and are never rewritten by odds migrations

locks.strategy: PostgreSQL row lock plus optimistic compare-and-set
locks.identityLock: SELECT FOR UPDATE on odds_market during current_version update
locks.compareAndSet: lock_version must match the command snapshot before mutation
locks.deadlockPolicy: stable aggregate ordering and bounded retry outside the candidate
locks.partialWritePolicy: single transaction rolls back fact, head pointer, audit and command receipt together

idempotency.samePayload: return the original result_reference without another fact
idempotency.differentPayload: reject with no new rows or head mutation

compatibility.legacyReaders: continue reading V16/V24 without requiring odds rows
compatibility.legacyWriters: remain unchanged; odds does not alter sports result or lifecycle history
compatibility.confirmedVersionReference: nullable for a pre-game market, exact and admissible when a historical sporting result is used
compatibility.eventPreGame: may exist without a result head or confirmedVersionId
compatibility.regulationAndAsOf: store the versioned regulation and as-of cut used by each calculation
compatibility.roster: binding and atomicity remain owned by 04-19
compatibility.rollback: conceptual rollback is a forward-fix migration; applied migrations are never edited

04-09: literal migration, PostgreSQL enforcement and persistence tests after fresh gate
